description: My Scoop Tools - scoop-deepclean: one-click deep cleanup (scoop cleanup * + scoop cache rm * + bun/uv/pnpm cache with per-item confirmation; prompts to kill locking processes; uv cache-lock aware).
notes: Local file:// URL: aria2 will warn and fall back to the built-in downloader (normal).
After editing scripts: bump version + git commit + 'scoop update mytools' + 'scoop update myScoopTools'.
